case_selection_rule: In frozen evaluation pair order: first positive planning-minus-baseline points; first negative points; first zero points difference with planning TOP_OUT. Missing categories stay empty. No narrative-based reselection.

method.population: Only 24 formal episodes on 12 paired seeds; calibration excluded. Repeated goals/actions are not independent samples.
method.geometry: Every saved goal/action recomputes all 40 conditional projections with the frozen build_landing_projections. Baseline computation is post-hoc only, never supplied to its model.
method.reachability: Conditional clear option means pose_valid and lines_cleared > 0 under instantaneous hypothetical pose alignment; it does NOT mean reachable by real timed inputs.
method.goal_distributions: All original goal IDs including keep/clear are counted. Explicit new targets count target:* responses, even if the ID equals an older target. Null predicted values remain null, not zero. Per-action targets include retained memory.
method.opportunity_denominators: Conditional-clear goal counts use all goal calls; selected includes a keep retaining such a target. Explicit-target counts exclude keep/clear. Per-action counts use the actual target after any planning call at that step.
method.target_reached: Before the selected native action: actual active cell minimum x equals target.leftmost_column AND native rotation equals target.rotation. No y condition or path claim.
method.hard_drop: Only native hard-drop:100 actions; observed line/point deltas come from after minus before. Being at a target or having a hypothetical clear result is not credited as actual success.
method.locked_piece_count: (locked cells after - before + 10*actual newly cleared lines)/4, including locks from soft drop or gravity; hold alone is not a lock.
method.actual_cells: Case events show actual active cells BEFORE the chosen action; hypothetical landing cells are labeled conditional and are never described as observed locked cells.
method.score: Frozen native final points remain the outcome. Geometry counts neither alter scores nor replace the registered paired score confidence interval.
method.causality: Read-only exploratory behavioral descriptions; no causal mechanism or game-strength claim from repeated action counts.
method.scope: No model calls, new trials, source edits, policy changes, experiment writes, native action filtering or promotion.
